description:
[read-only] Who changed one campaign on its network and when (Meta, Google), each entry marked source flayr, outside (Ads Manager or another tool) or unknown. Page with `after` = the previous `next`. Read only.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/campaigns/{id}/change-log.)

after.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

since.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the configured number of days.

name: ads_campaign_change_log
title: Campaign change log
